sections.changelog:
Fixed

  • **Products with no category are no longer imported in "include only" mode.** When the category filter is set to import only the ticked branches, a product whose feed entry carries an empty category id used to slip past the filter and land in the catalogue uncategorised. Such a product belongs to none of the ticked branches, so it is now dropped — matching the operator's intent of importing only the selected categories. In exclude mode (and when no filter is configured) products without a category are still kept, exactly as before.
